material_results.interpretation: B01 produced a result, but full independent-oracle agreement over the frozen probe set did not satisfy the R2 certificate. The close split-adaptive/mpmath witness agreement is positive diagnostic evidence only.

endpoint_theory_reconciliation_before_r2.finding: The same-sign lower/upper residuals for B12, O13 and O14 are not sufficient to classify the failure as a quadrature artifact. For van Genuchten-Mualem with a sharp but integrable near-saturation K(h) decline, the q -> KSAT+ unsaturated path-length limit can be finite. If that limiting unsaturated path is shorter than the 5 cm face, no strictly interior q>KSAT root exists; a q=KSAT endpoint/free-boundary solution with an h=0 saturated plateau is then a physically distinct possibility that R2 did not test.
endpoint_theory_reconciliation_before_r2.numerical_issue_still_present: R2 also evaluated the lower bracket at machine-nextafter above KSAT using direct adaptive head quadrature and emitted convergence/roundoff warnings, so the limiting path itself was not independently certified.
endpoint_theory_reconciliation_before_r2.required_repair: R2R1 must independently evaluate the q->KSAT+ path-length limit before searching for an interior q>KSAT root. It must admit an endpoint q=KSAT branch only if two independent endpoint-robust evaluations agree that the limiting unsaturated path is shorter than the face.

hard_nonclaims: R2 does not falsify or qualify the inherited legacy steady_q reference.
R2 does not qualify or falsify the Ross candidate face.
R2 does not establish that an interior q>KSAT root must exist for every surface-to-unsaturated head pair.
The prior 5 cm boundary-face failure remains binding until a valid independent oracle and fresh qualification exist.
No finite-positive ponding-head, surface-process, runoff or production admission follows from R2.
No R2 threshold is relaxed after observing the failures.
